guidelines: Treat participant evidence as revision-bound; unchanged answers do not prove a new reading session.

constraints: Do not alter raw participant answer content or timestamps.
Do not impersonate an independent reader or synthesize a fresh receipt.
Do not modify the three-language P0 entry pages in this Work Item.
Do not claim publication or release readiness.
